goal: Allow RPC callers to request feerate outputs in sat/vB instead of BTC/kvB across several node and mempool RPCs
Avoid rounding artifacts and manual conversions for downstream tooling and users
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Substantive support for backwards-compatible migration to sat/vB (musaHaruna)
Concept approval without stated reasons (jonatack, w0xlt)

why: P3 because it aligns RPC feerate units with common tooling and avoids manual conversion errors
